hook: There are two kinds of rich in America: old money and new money. They both have wealth, but they earn, spend and protect it very differently. In this video I go through 20 differences from three angles: the financial numbers, the psychology of status and risk, and the playbook old money families use to keep wealth for generations, plus what new money does better.
shorts: Most family fortunes vanish by the third generation. Here's why
The rich use debt very differently than everyone else
One of America's richest families lost almost everything. Here's how
Old money whispers. New money shouts. Here's the difference
Self made money has one big advantage old money doesn't
